description: Air temperature and the physics weather environment (rg::ClimateConfig, core/include/rg/climate.h). The ONE source of the air temperature: the weather widget shows climate_temperature_c(...) and the physics environment installed in rg::Session (V8) is pinned to the same value (WeatherPresetDesc::temp_override_c, lifted to the car's altitude by the ISA lapse). T = mean(day) + range(day)/2 * (1 - cloud_range_reduction * cloud) * cos(2 pi (solar_h - peak_solar_hour) / 24) - lapse_k_per_m * (altitude - station elevation); mean/range interpolated between the monthly midpoints; solar_h = UT + longitude/15 (local mean solar time).

source.monthly: ASSUMED approximations of the DWD 1991-2020 normals for Frankfurt/Main (monthly mean air temperature, mean daily maximum minus minimum, relative humidity); not re-read from the DWD tables. ground_temp_c: soil about 1 m deep [AS]. pressure: [AS].
source.temperature: lapse 0.0065 K/m = ISA (the physics lifts the station value with the same lapse); peak 14:30 local mean solar time [AS, typical mid-afternoon maximum]; cloud_range_reduction 0.6 = physics_sim diurnal_temperature default.
source.resync: rg::WeatherSync re-sends the pinned temperature when it moved by temperature_k, and the clock when the physics environment drifted from the game clock by more than max(clock_s, clock_real_s x rate) game seconds [AS].
source.physics: lags/precip_phase/humidity/diurnal/lightning blocks copied from physics_sim data/climates/test_weather.json (required by its WeatherTimeline even in Preset mode; the diurnal curve is unused because every preset pins the temperature); condition.spinup_s 1 day [AS: shorter spin-up after a backward clock jump].
source.weather: ASSUMED game presets per sky.json weather id: rain 4 mm/h (WMO moderate), thunder 15 mm/h with 4 strikes/min, snow 1.5 mm/h water equivalent, hail 10 mm/h of 15 mm stones; wind/rh plausible for the phenomenon.
